title: fix(dev): exclude runtime state from gateway reload

target.summary: Excluding the absolute path of backend/sandbox in uvicorn's --reload-exclude without ensuring the directory exists causes uvicorn to fall back to Path.glob(). On Python 3.12, globbing an absolute pattern raises NotImplementedError, crashing dev gateway startup on fresh checkouts.
notes: mkdir fails to create /app/backend/sandbox before passing it to uvicorn --reload-exclude
mkdir fails to create $REPO_ROOT/backend/sandbox before passing it to uvicorn --reload-exclude
